criteria.description: CartPage renders a list of cart items alongside an order summary with subtotal, discount, shipping, and total.
criteria.notes: Verify via CartPage story populated state and, if available, unit test assertions.

criteria.description: CartPage uses a two-column layout on desktop (≥1024px) and a single stacked column on mobile (<1024px).
criteria.notes: Verify via Storybook viewport tests or visual regression at 1440px and 375px.

criteria.description: HomePage renders a responsive grid of ProductCard widgets.
criteria.notes: Verify grid column count changes across breakpoints in HomePage story.

criteria.description: HomePage is populated with at least six mock products so the grid is visually complete.
criteria.notes: Verify src/shared/mocks/products.ts exports ≥6 products and HomePage renders all of them.

criteria.description: Both pages import only from widgets, features, entities, and shared layers; no cross-page imports.
criteria.notes: Verify via npm run lint:arch (Steiger FSD linter) passing with zero violations.

criteria.description: CartPage shows an empty-state message when the cart contains no items.
criteria.notes: Verify via CartPage story with empty items array; CartList auto-renders EmptyState.
